title: Called back from leave through a blizzard before Base 2 duty

tellings.quote: And it was a blizzard. There was a blizzard the entire way home.

plain: In the early 1990s, a young Air Force sergeant on leave was called back to his base and had to drive back through a snowstorm before starting duty at a posting he calls Base 2. Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for communications, trained him to speak with aliens, tells it as his own memory: "There was a blizzard the entire way home." It is part of how he says his secret assignment began.
